title: GitHub issue-comment external-effect verification
description: Requirements for establishing that a recorded local agent operation is exactly correlated to an observed GitHub issue-comment record, without claiming cryptographic record authenticity.

scope.system_boundary: One explicitly selected local OTLP trace artifact plus one bounded GitHub issue-comment evidence envelope acquired locally by stable comment ID.
scope.reconstruction_question: Does an external GitHub record exist for the exact operation identifier recorded by this agent execution?
exclusions: provider acceptance before the comment became observable
cryptographic authenticity of the GitHub record
effects outside the selected issue comment

requires.rationale: The trace must record the operation that was requested, independently of whether the destination changed.
The trace must retain the stable external operation identifier used for the destination join.
The destination record must be read from GitHub and joined to the selected trace by the exact comment identifier.

notes: GitHub API retrieval over TLS is not a cryptographic proof of record authenticity.
A matching destination record does not reveal hidden reasoning or establish effects outside that record.
